answer: Take a Gitcoin Passport-style stamp score. First, each agent's owner links outside credentials: a GitHub account over two years old, an ENS name, a verified phone. Second, every stamp carries a weight and the ledger sums them. Third, only identities scoring 20 or more may attest. Fourth, stamps are rechecked every 30 days, so one revoked credential drops you under the bar. An attacker wanting 1,000 voters must buy about 4,000 aged accounts at roughly $12 each, near $48,000, then keep them alive. A sybil farm is a dune of sand; each recheck is a river that washes it off, leaving marble.
